ranked for beginner to intermediate lifters:
small jumps, a setup you can repeat, safe to train alone.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#5 barbell back squat
great lift, but heavy sets alone need the safeties set right every time.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#4 walking lunges
space and step length change, so sessions are hard to compare.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#3 bulgarian split squat
balance limits the load early. add reps before weight.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#2 romanian deadlift
small plate jumps. keep the same depth each week so it compares.

bonus tip: you can't beat last week if you can't see it.
i'm building EARND for that.

#1 leg press
same seat, safety stops, small plate jumps. the easiest to repeat and beat.
